# 100.00 USD bought into C at 1.40, the split stating
# `cost_basis_brought_in: "60.00"`.
#
# What a split brought in across zero is read from its account's balance on
# the transaction's date when it is imported, and no export writes it. A file
# may not state it, so the transaction is refused.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "Buy 100.00 USD at 1.40 into C"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD C 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "140.00"
		cost_basis_brought_in: "60.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -140.00 CAD
